gripOrHq.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

heapOrArchives.title: Priority Wreck
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

heapOrArchives.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

heapOrArchives.title: Forged Activation Orders
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

heapOrArchives.title: Startup Immolator
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Startup Immolator
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Edited Shipping Manifests
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, and the Corp has any credits when you would access HQ, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [1] and gives you a tag, and you gain [10].

rig.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
rig.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Ice Transmutation
scoreArea.rulesText: Choose a piece of rezzed ice when you score Ice Transmutation. That ice now has +1 strength, and each subroutine on it is repeated once. Treat this as if each repeated subroutine appeared immediately after the original subroutine.

root.title: Olivia Salazar
root.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.
